exposure: nPCR for Tpp15 membrane protein DNA
nPCR for Tpp17 membrane protein DNA
nPCR for Tpp45 membrane protein DNA
nPCR for Tpp47 membrane protein DNA (using two pairs of primers, a and b)
outcome: Sensitivity of nPCR for diagnosing congenital syphilis
cohort: The study included 30 newborns diagnosed with congenital syphilis and 20 control newborns admitted to hospital for other reasons.
finding: The sensitivity of nPCR for Tpp47 was found to be the highest among the four membrane protein DNA types, and using two different pairs of primers for Tpp47 could elevate nPCR sensitivity.
